title: THE 1000 YEAR MILLENNIUM

blocks.text: “This letter answers questions concerning the beginning and the end of the 1000 year millennium. The first part of Chap. 14 of Zechariah reveals the starting of this. But let us start with verse 16 where it reveals all those who are left after the battle shall go up each year to worship the King (Jesus the Lord of Hosts) and to keep the feast of Tabernacles!” Micah 4:2, “reveals this also and the governmental law of the Lord will go forth!” – Zech. Chap. 8, “reveals the restoration of Jerusalem also! Zech. 13:9 reveals they will be refined as rare metal is refined in the fire and they will know their God!” Joel Chap. 3, “gives more confirmation!” Joel 2:32, “reveals the Lord’s great mercy.” Now these Scriptures give you a general scope and it cannot be denied, but the Lord will bring Israel into the Millennium! Let us proceed with some very vital and interesting things concerning these thousand years! First let us show what happens at the end of it, then we will return and explain the period of it all! Zech. 14:17, “And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King (Jesus), the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain!” “No doubt representatives of each family are ordered to go to Jerusalem each year to worship the king. Evidently also sonic aircraft is used to carry some of them!” Read Isa. 60:8, “wherein it says, Some fly as a cloud and as doves to their windows (hangars)!” “This same chapter deals with the Millennium too. Zech. 14:18 reminds them again that those who do not come up, there will be no rain, and the drought is called a plague of punishment upon the heathen who do not come up to keep the feast of the Tabernacles!” – “What occurred is that they went back into sins and idolatry and did not come up and rebellion set in! They challenged God and were as the sands of the sea around Jerusalem!” (Rev. 20:7-9) – “And God hurled fire upon them and they become as ashes! Verse 10 reveals the devil himself came up with the hordes!” “This is different than the battle of Armageddon, it occurred a thousand years earlier after the Tribulation!” (Rev. 16:16-21) – “But let us return to Zech. 14:20 at the start of the millennium, “In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD (JESUS); and the pots in the Lord’s house shall be like the bowls before the altar!” – Verse 21, “explains that every pot in Jerusalem shall be holy unto the Lord, it also explains about sacrifice and that God will remove the evil seed from among them!”

Zech. 14:14, “reveals just before the Millennium, Judah gathered up the wealth of silver and gold in great abundance!” From this verse and other verses in the Bible evidently reveals gold plays an important part just before and greatly during the Tribulation! But finally because food is so scarce during the time, it can hardly even purchase food entering and more so during the Great Tribulation! (Rev. 6:5-8) Verse 6, “reveals a person will work all day just for a quart of wheat, it says ‘penny’ which means a ‘denarius’!” (Read Matt 20:2) – “We don’t know the exact price of other things during tribulation time, but food has again skyrocketed on the earth in price!” “Finally to receive food measured out you must receive a controlled mark!” (Rev. 13:17) Plus verses 5 and 6 reveal payment to the world church system for sins! – “False wheat (bread), symbol of life but which is actually death in this case!” Rev. 17:4-5.

“During the 1000 years the Bride lives in the higher realm with Jesus!” – “But let us list some interesting things which happen during the Millennium. Matt. 19:28, the 12 tribes will rule over the earth and the people who are left of the nations.” “This will be the Lord’s real government and a revolutionary age of the Lord Jesus to His people Israel!” “The Millennium inventive age will be advanced ahead of this age now! And people will live to be nearly a thousand years old!” (Isa. 65:20-23) – “Here is something interesting in Isa. 66:24, it reveals they get a glimpse of what God does to their tormenters after the Millennium.” During the Millennium we see what the economic standard is that the Lord sets up for trading and wealth among the families. Gold is mentioned. (Read Isa. 60:6-9, 17) There will be no inflated prices then. Probably Joseph will have control of the agriculture and the food as he was well trained before in this, because at the end of the Millennium when the rebellion starts he tells them why they are in drought and probably withholds food until they correct themselves! But in their madness they want to challenge Jesus! (Rev. 20:9 – Zech. 14:17) “Besides all order and law will come from Jesus to the 12 Tribes governing the earth!” During the millennium, the weather pattern will be marvelous and changed back even better than it was before the flood (Isa. 30:23-26) – (Isa. 4:2) and will produce 10 times the abundance in food, except at the end of the millennium when drought occurs! Finally after the millennium there will be no more need for the sun or the moon, for the Lord Jesus will be the light! And then there will be a new heaven and new earth and the Holy City coming down! (Rev. 21:1-5, 23) – “This is after the millennium and thousand years and the White Throne Judgment is over!” – “All tears are wiped away and it is the beginning of ultra new things forever!” – “I’m sorry I had to skip around some in this letter, but I feel the Lord had me to do it this way so you would read it several times and gain knowledge and understanding!”
